# FLE Link

> FLE Link runs big local AI models in one command. It reads your machine, installs the inference engine that fits,
> downloads a model that fits, picks the settings and serves an OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API, a browser Studio
> and a desktop app. Open source (MIT), no account, no telemetry. macOS, Linux, Windows.

With the FLE engine (FastLocalExperts, a llama.cpp fork for mixture-of-experts models) FLE Link runs DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
(763 billion parameters, 2-bit GGUF) at about 50 tokens per second on one 32 GB GPU with 128 GB RAM
(120 GB of it for the model, 8 GB left to the system). The measurements and
how they were taken are on https://sirfyyn.de/en/fle/.

Install:

    curl -fsSL https://flelink.run/install.sh | sh        (macOS, Linux)
    irm https://flelink.run/install.ps1 | iex             (Windows)

## Pages

- [FLE Link](https://flelink.run/): the first run uncut, which model fits which card, the speed comparison, what happens when things break
- [Privacy](https://flelink.run/privacy.html): what the site and the program do with data
- [Terms of use](https://flelink.run/terms.html)

## Source and documentation

- [FLE Link on GitHub](https://github.com/sirfyyn/flelink): source, releases, README
- [How it works](https://github.com/sirfyyn/flelink/blob/main/docs/HOW-IT-WORKS.md): every rule and number
- [Recipes](https://github.com/sirfyyn/flelink/blob/main/docs/RECIPES.md): model, engine and settings in one file
- [FLE engine (FastLocalExperts)](https://github.com/sirfyyn/FastLocalExperts): the llama.cpp fork FLE Link installs for mixture-of-experts models
- [FLE Durable](https://github.com/sirfyyn/fle-durable): an always-on local agent that runs next to the model

## Models

- [Rin: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017, 2-bit GGUF](https://huggingface.co/sirfyyn/Rin-Deepseek-V4.1-Flash-1017-FLE-GGUF)
- [DSpark draft model for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash](https://huggingface.co/sirfyyn/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-DSpark-FLE-GGUF)
- [All models on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/sirfyyn)
